guidance.heading: Guidance update
section: For the full year 2026, expected payable gold production remains at the low end of the range of 3.3 to 3.5 million ounces, reflecting the adjusted mine plan for the Barnat open pit at Canadian Malartic. Full year total cash costs per ounce and AISC per ounce guidance for 2026 are expected to be near the upper end of the guidance range of $1,020 to $1,120 and $1,400 to $1,550, respectively, reflecting the revised production plan and input cost pressures.

Total capital expenditures for 2026 (excluding capitalized exploration) remain between $2.6 billion and $2.8 billion, and expected capitalized exploration remains between $290.0 million and $330.0 million.

The Company now expects depreciation and amortization expense to be towards the upper end of the $1.55 billion to $1.75 billion guidance range, primarily due to a higher amortization rate used at Canadian Malartic following adjustments to the Barnat open pit mine plan. The revised mine plan uses a higher units-of-production amortization rate resulting from a decrease in the total tonnes milled over the life of mine.
